verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs describe built-in AI that performs tasks: building reports and dashboards from prompts (e.g., "Show me headcount vs plan"), letting employees ask questions and submit qualifying life events with AI, and automatically reviewing dependent documents to approve coverage. These are feature-specific AI capabilities rather than a documented general-purpose assistant that users can delegate arbitrary tasks to. The "Delegate tasks" payroll copy refers to role permissions, not AI, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose in-product AI assistant/agent, detail on the breadth of tasks it can execute across modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
